note: Premium bodies: realistic zombies sold for in-game currency. Ids are stable and stored in saves once the runtime contract (src/shared/cast.ts) adopts them; never rename. Each body is published in two representations of the SAME design on the 22-bone cast rig: `high` (its own declared budget below) and `low` (the unchanged cast budget in lib/config.py), so the purchase selects the design and the hardware selects the detail.
